result.question: What happens to Jeroboam's hand?

readings.answer: It withers so he cannot pull it back.
readings.support: the hand he stretched out toward him withered, so that he could not pull it back

assessments.reason: The passage says “the hand he stretched out toward him withered,” which is synonymous with “dried up,” and adds “so that he could not pull it back,” matching the outcome.
“He stretched it out” describes Jeroboam’s action, not what happened to his hand; the text then states what happened: it “withered,” i.e., dried up.

result.reason: The text explicitly states Jeroboam’s hand “withered,” which matches the key’s “dried up.”
